name: Cerebras Systems
description: Designer of the Wafer-Scale Engine 3 AI inference chip and cloud-based AI compute service; counts OpenAI and AWS as customers.
read_across: A $56B Cerebras listing establishes a pure-play AI-inference comp that pressures NVDA's monopoly narrative and validates AMD's rival inference ambitions.

name: SpaceX
description: Vertically integrated rocket, Starlink satellite internet, and xAI division — the largest IPO ever by gross proceeds.
read_across: A $1.77T SpaceX listing instantly revalues ASTS, RKLB, and LUNR as small-cap proxies while compressing satellite-broadband TAM for DISH and legacy telecoms.

name: X-energy
description: Developer of the Xe-100 small modular reactor and TRISO nuclear fuel; backed by Amazon, Dow, and Jane Street for 5+ GW of contracted power.
read_across: X-energy's SMR premium re-rates OKLO and NuScale on a technology-licensing model, and signals that hyperscalers will pay through-the-cycle offtake prices for 24/7 carbon-free power.

name: Fervo Energy
description: Advanced geothermal energy developer supplying baseload, carbon-free electricity to data centers; backed by Breakthrough Energy Ventures and Devon Energy.
read_across: Fervo's $10B debut validates next-gen geothermal as a credible grid asset, pressuring NEE and AES to accelerate geothermal M&A to protect their power-to-datacenter pipelines.

name: Generate Biomedicines
description: Clinical-stage generative biology company using AI to design proteins and drug molecules for previously undruggable targets.
read_across: GENB's listing gives the market a pure-play generative-biology comp that re-rates RXRX and SEER on AI-designed drug probability of success, while pressuring Genentech to defend its structure-based design moat.

name: Lyntris
description: Defense technology company delivering sense-to-act connectivity for multi-domain battlespace; formed by merger of Accelerint and Vitesse Systems.
read_across: Lyntris's NYSE debut expands the investable defense-autonomy comp set, directly re-rating L3Harris and CACI on battlespace connectivity multiples.

name: Syntiant
description: Ultra-low-power AI processor and full-stack physical AI platform for always-on edge intelligence in audio, vision, and sensor applications.
read_across: A Syntiant listing prices always-on edge-AI silicon as a discrete category, putting MCHP and QCOM's embedded-AI ambitions under multiple pressure if edge inference proves margin-rich.

name: Csquare
description: Carrier-neutral data center colocation and interconnection platform across US, Canada, and UK, serving AI-enabled cloud workloads.
read_across: Csquare's NYSE listing benchmarks private colocation multiples against EQIX and DLR, compressing or expanding their premiums depending on whether Csquare prices AI-capacity scarcity into rents.

name: Anthropic
description: Creator of the Claude family of AI models and Claude Code agentic coding assistant; revenue run rate of $47B as of mid-2026.
read_across: An Anthropic listing near $1T sets a forward-revenue multiple for the AI-model layer that forces MSFT and GOOG to justify their AI capex-to-revenue ratios in real time.

name: OpenAI
description: Creator of ChatGPT and GPT-4o with 900M+ weekly active users; confidential S-1 filed June 2026 after structural conversion from nonprofit.
read_across: An OpenAI public listing would be the defining valuation benchmark for the entire AI software stack, immediately repricing MSFT's Azure-OpenAI revenue share and Google's Gemini monetization argument.

name: Spin AI
description: AI-driven SaaS security and data-protection platform for enterprise cloud applications, guarding against ransomware, shadow AI, and data exposure.
read_across: Spin AI's listing creates a pure-play SaaS-security comp that forces CrowdStrike and Zscaler to demonstrate they can replicate behavioral SaaS monitoring at platform margins.

name: HawkEye 360
description: Radio frequency intelligence company using a commercial satellite constellation to detect, characterize, and geolocate RF signals for military customers.
read_across: HawkEye 360's NYSE filing re-rates ASTS and Palantir's geospatial-intelligence business as pure spectrum-surveillance comparables surge on defense-budget tailwinds.

name: Anduril Industries
description: Defense autonomy company making AI-powered drones, missiles, and Lattice OS for the US military; $2.2B 2025 revenue; $100B valuation talks in July 2026.
read_across: An Anduril IPO near $100B would directly re-rate Lockheed Martin and Northrop Grumman as incumbents fighting for vertical-integration relevance against a software-native defense prime.

name: Shield AI
description: Autonomous flight software (Hivemind) and V-BAT UAV maker; selected by USAF for CCA Collaborative Combat Aircraft program; $540M+ projected 2026 revenue.
read_across: A Shield AI public listing benchmarks autonomy-software multiples against Palantir's 60x forward revenue, compelling L3Harris and Textron to pay up for any remaining autonomy M&A targets.

name: Unitree Robotics
description: China's leading humanoid robot manufacturer (G1 model); first humanoid to list on Shanghai's STAR market; backed by DeepSeek and Chinese government funds.
read_across: A $9B Unitree STAR listing raises the valuation bar for all humanoid-robot manufacturers and forces Tesla's Optimus and Figure AI to match aggressive Chinese cost curves in investor presentations.

name: Databricks
description: Data lakehouse and AI platform with $7B+ revenue run rate and 80%+ YoY growth; raised $5B at $190B in August 2026; IPO repeatedly deferred.
read_across: Any Databricks IPO announcement would force Snowflake to defend its data-warehouse multiple against a larger, faster-growing AI-native platform trading at a premium.

name: Yellow.ai
description: Enterprise agentic AI platform for service automation with 16B conversations/year across 650+ enterprise clients; going public via SPAC merger with Bluerock Acquisition Corp.
read_across: Yellow.ai's SPAC listing tests whether agentic-AI-for-CX can command SaaS multiples, directly pressuring Five9 and NICE inContact on AI-displacement narrative.

name: GrubMarket
description: AI-powered food supply chain platform with $2B+ revenue and GrubAssist AI suite for wholesalers and distributors; confidential S-1 filed July 2026.
read_across: GrubMarket's IPO reprices vertical-SaaS-plus-marketplace hybrids in agriculture, giving AGCO and Corteva a software-valuation comp that highlights the hardware discount in legacy agri companies.

name: Kailera Therapeutics
description: Developer of oral and injectable treatments for obesity and metabolic disease, advancing next-generation GLP-1 receptor agonists.
read_across: Kailera's $718M raise reinforces the GLP-1 obesity-drug mega-cycle and re-rates Viking Therapeutics and Structure Therapeutics as next-wave acqui-hire targets for Eli Lilly and Novo Nordisk.

name: Alamar Biosciences
description: Applies proteomics and AI to early disease detection; ultra-sensitive protein biomarker platform targeting liquid biopsy and multi-cancer early detection.
read_across: Alamar's proteomics listing competes directly with Seer and Olink for liquid-biopsy multiple, forcing Illumina to defend its genomics dominance narrative against protein-first diagnostics.

name: Applied Aerospace and Defense
description: Huntsville, AL-based supplier of propellant tanks, antennas, engine nozzles, and payload adapters for defense and space missions; $500M 2025 revenue.
read_across: Applied Aerospace's NYSE listing creates a component-supply comp that pressures Moog and Heico on space-hardware margins as commercial launch cadence accelerates.

name: American Battery Materials
description: Exploration-stage US critical minerals company developing direct lithium extraction from Utah's Paradox Basin brine deposits; NYSE American uplisting.
read_across: BLTH's NYSE uplisting highlights the domestic critical-minerals investment gap and re-rates ALB and SQM on US lithium supply security arguments favored by IRA-era policy.

name: Seaport Therapeutics
description: Boston biotech developing psychedelic-inspired and neurosteroid medicines for depression, anxiety, and neuropsychiatric disorders using proprietary delivery science.
read_across: Seaport's listing prices the CNS-neuropsychiatric pipeline against AbbVie's Cerevel acquisition and forces AXSM and INVA to defend their depression drug multiples against next-gen mechanisms.

name: Hemab
description: Denmark-based biotech developing treatments for rare blood coagulation disorders, including thrombomodulin-based agents for hemophilia.
read_across: Hemab's Nasdaq listing re-rates Sanofi-Genzyme's hemophilia franchise and forces BioMarin to price next-generation coagulation mechanisms into its pipeline value.

name: Saronic
description: Builder of autonomous maritime vessels for US Navy and USCG missions; raised significant 2026 funding amid defense-autonomy boom.
read_across: A Saronic IPO creates the first pure-play autonomous surface vessel comp, directly pressuring HII and Austal on traditional naval shipbuilding margins as the Navy shifts to autonomous surface fleets.

name: AgiBot
description: Chinese humanoid robot manufacturer competing with Unitree; seeking IPO listing in Hong Kong following Unitree's successful STAR market debut.
read_across: AgiBot's HK listing extends the humanoid-robot public comp set and forces Boston Dynamics parent Hyundai to acknowledge the valuation gap between private-market enthusiasm and revenue reality.

name: Klarna
description: Swedish BNPL and AI-powered payments platform with 150M+ consumers; repeatedly named in credible 2026 US IPO reporting alongside Stripe.
read_across: Klarna's US IPO would directly reprice AFRM and SoFi on BNPL economics while signaling whether European fintech can achieve US growth-stock multiples on a Nasdaq listing.

name: Razorpay
description: India's leading payments and fintech infrastructure company; filed pre-DRHP with SEBI seeking $500-600M in a domestic Indian IPO.
read_across: Razorpay's SEBI filing prices India's payments infrastructure at a premium that compresses Paytm's discount while signaling to VISA and Mastercard that domestic Indian rails may commoditize cross-border margins.

name: Leju Robotics
description: Chinese humanoid robot company seeking listing on Shenzhen exchange; part of the wave of Chinese humanoid manufacturers racing to public markets post-Unitree.
read_across: Leju's Shenzhen listing deepens the humanoid-robot investable universe, intensifying valuation scrutiny on Boston Dynamics and NVIDIA's Isaac robotics platform as pure-play comps multiply.

name: Mobia Medical
description: Austin-based developer of a nerve-stimulation device for stroke recovery; filed S-1 in April 2026 targeting rehab neurology market.
read_across: Mobia's listing benchmarks non-invasive neuromodulation against Nevro and Nalu Medical, giving MDVN and Abbott a read on how the market prices clinical-stage neurostimulation absent insurance reimbursement clarity.

name: Swarmer
description: Defense drone swarming company that had a soaring public debut in 2026, referenced as an early marker for defense-tech IPO appetite.
read_across: Swarmer's pop set the benchmark for autonomous-drone multiples and validated investor willingness to price software-defined munitions at premiums over legacy defense hardware primes.

name: LimX Dynamics
description: Chinese robotics company building bipedal and quadruped robots; founder stated publicly that 'listing is a must' following Unitree's successful debut.
read_across: LimX's IPO intent extends the Chinese humanoid comp wave and puts pressure on US robotics developers to accelerate commercialization timelines before the cost-curve gap with Chinese manufacturers widens further.
